coverage_summary: Reviewed all 17 trajectories against the supplied paper text. The core BIOREASON construction is partly supported, but several trajectories omit explicitly documented operations or add unsupported attention and DNA-only evaluation behavior. Enformer hybrid and chromatin-task LLM routes are also missing.

findings.detail: The Qwen3-4B fine-tuning trajectory collapses the documented Evo2 tokenization, frozen DNA encoding, linear projection, query/special-token embedding lookups, stacking, and RoPE steps into an opaque boundary. The paper explicitly documents these operations, so the decomposition is incomplete.

is projected by a learnable linear layer
These components are then stacked along the sequence dimension
receive positional information via Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)

findings.required_change: Expand prepare_evo2_qwen3_input into the documented tokenizer, encoder, projection, embedding lookup, stacking, and RoPE calls, retaining unknown order and mask details as uncertainty.

findings.detail: The NT-500M Qwen3-1.7B fine-tuning trajectory omits the documented context-length truncation branch. Section 3.1 states that any tokenized DNA sequence exceeding the defined context length is truncated, independently of the selected DNA encoder.

evidence.quote: If an input S DNA sequence, after tokenization by T DNA, exceeds a defined context length (e.g., 2048 DNA tokens), it is truncated.

findings.required_change: Add the conditional truncation/select step and identity-through bypass before NT-500M encoding; preserve the truncation side as unspecified.

It also treats the representation as the output of an input-preparation step rather than preserving the documented sequence of operations.

findings.detail: The Evo2 DNA-only evaluation trajectory assigns the paper's deterministic-generation statement to DNA-only prediction, although the cited text covers LLM and DNA-LLM generations and does not document deterministic DNA-only generation. The deterministic_decoding control is also represented as a prediction output.

findings.required_change: Remove the unsupported deterministic-generation step from the DNA-only route, or represent only a documented evaluation control if separate evidence establishes it; keep the classifier output as the prediction.

findings.detail: The Enformer attention step invents a single learnable query vector and binds it as cross-attention input. The paper documents only a trained attention head; it does not establish query/key-value structure. The step also overwrites enformer_representation instead of introducing an attention-head output node.

evidence.quote: Enformer (DNA-only): Standalone Enformer with frozen weights and a trained attention head for classification.

findings.required_change: Represent the Enformer attention head as an opaque operation_id:null boundary receiving the Enformer output, or add a separate query only if the paper explicitly supports it; create a distinct output node if an output is claimed.

findings.detail: The paper evaluates Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B LLM-only models and Enformer-Qwen3 hybrid models on the chromatin-accessibility task, but the assembly contains only the Enformer DNA-only trajectory for this task.

evidence.quote: Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B (LLM-only): Qwen3 models fine-tuned on the task with DNA sequences treated as text.
Enformer-Qwen3-1.7B and Enformer-Qwen3-4B (DNA-LLM): BIOREASON hybrids integrating Enformer embeddings with Qwen3 backbones.

findings.required_change: Add the documented LLM-only and Enformer-Qwen3 chromatin-accessibility trajectories, using opaque boundaries for the unspecified Enformer embedding integration path.

findings.detail: The BIOREASON fine-tuning trajectories mention conditional GRPO in task_configuration but contain no conditional GRPO branch or phase. The paper states that selected BIOREASON models were subsequently optimized with GRPO, while the selected configurations are unspecified.

evidence.quote: Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning using the GRPO algorithm was subsequently applied to select DNA-LLM models.
Select BIOREASON models were further optimized with GRPO.

findings.required_change: Add a conditional, configuration-unspecified GRPO branch or remove the GRPO claim from the trajectory task configuration; preserve the selection uncertainty.
